topic_title: Value of ADE — Foundations for Reduced-Risk Driving
prompt: According to Texas vehicle inspection laws, what is the minimum legal tire tread depth required across the roadway contact surface?

options.text: At least 4/32 of an inch across the center tread contact
At least 2/32 of an inch of tread in all major grooves
At least 1/16 of an inch measured only on the outer ribs
At least 3/32 of an inch exclusively on front axle tires
